Path 3, developer platformGOALS §5.5

Backstage

The open-source developer portal most of the industry starts from.

WHAT IT IS

A CNCF Incubating framework from Spotify: software catalog, scaffolder templates, TechDocs and a large plugin ecosystem, assembled into an internal portal.

WHAT SETS IT APART

The most flexible, with the largest community; BackstageCon was a full day. But it's a TypeScript application we'd build, upgrade and staff, not an install.

WHERE WE STAND

Decide after the paved road works. The catalog and the placement vocabulary carry the value, and can exist before any portal.

BackstageCon; "Backstage's Role in AI-Assisted Development" (DoorDash, Spotify), KubeCon NA 2026

DECIDE

Backstage: The open-source developer portal most of the industry starts from. Where we stand: Decide after the paved road works. The catalog and the placement vocabulary carry the value, and can exist before any portal. The question to ask of any portal: who maintains the plugins, and does it actually deploy anything?
